import MeasureTheory.AEMeasurable
import MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
import Real

open MeasureTheory

theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} (t : ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ := by
  have h_mul : AEMeasurable (fun ω => t * X ω) μ := AEMeasurable.mul_const hX t
  have h_strong_mul : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => t * X ω) μ := AEStronglyMeasurable.mul_const hX t
  exact AEStronglyMeasurable.exp h_strong_mul
